diagnosis: The deterministic vol-target overlay delivered exactly what sizing overlays promise - higher risk-adjusted return (OOS Sharpe 1.892 vs 1.773 incumbent), shallower drawdowns (-23.3% vs -38.3%), 68% less turnover - and cleared BOTH the charter bar and the pre-declared primary acceptance (+0.119 >= +0.10 Sharpe margin). But the conjunctive claim required gates G2-G5 and three failed: IS significance p=0.082 (in-sample edge not established at the 5% bar; borderline-flag false yet still > 0.05 = failure per prereg), CPCV fold-5-alone negative (-0.000161, 1/62 combinations), and permutation-null survival missed with observed 1.374 sitting below the null MEAN 1.384 (p95 1.478) - the OOS excess-Sharpe level is statistically indistinguishable from block-shuffled luck given the dominant momentum drift of this window. Pattern echoes H2: real economic improvement in the realized path, no demonstrable statistical edge over its own randomization null. Verdict FAIL per kill criteria; no threshold nudging, no sigma-window retuning, no post-hoc clamp changes permitted. SIZING lane remains OPEN only via a NEW prereg with changed conditions (e.g. different target-vol parameterization declared ex ante plus evidence addressing the permutation-null failure mode).
